The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Priest/Legends|priest]] [[Harrar]] possessed a '''priestship'''. It was present at [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]] after it was [[First Battle of Obroa-skai|conquered]], and the [[priestship]] served as a base of operations of sorts for Harrar and [[Nom Anor]]'s plot to use [[bo'tous]] to infect [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].
